vo: Ever feel buried under endless client brief emails?
They want perfect campaigns fast, but you’re stuck sorting chaos.
Your client drops a brief, our AI reads it instantly.
It extracts goals, budget, assets, and creates a Trello card.
The draft lands in your inbox for a quick approval.
All data syncs to Google Sheet and fires an email to the team.
reel.insight_note: Agencies are overwhelmed by repetitive brief intake, making a quick AI fix highly relevant.
reel.caption:
🚀 Agencies, stop drowning in messy client briefs. An AI bot can instantly parse a brief, create a Trello task, update a Google Sheet, and email your team—no manual copy‑pasting.
